rationale: Authoritative CBCG bank register — mine once for the actor/foreign-parent map, refresh periodically; fetch failure is soft only.
Regulator press-release feed that names bank management by role and date — durable leadership-move signal stream.
CKB management/board roster page is a cheap diff target for OTP-driven leadership changes at the Montenegrin subsidiary.
Third-party aggregator with unclear ToS and failed verification; secondary to primary registers and bank sites.
Group job feeds are genuinely predictive of leadership/hiring moves but LinkedIn requires login and restricts scraping — human must clear access.
Legally mandated register of payment institutions and agents — the seed actor universe for the whole non-bank payments employer map.
EMI register is currently empty; monitoring the zero-state makes any first entry a clean market-entry and hiring trigger.
Payment-system operator register covers the infrastructure employer layer; operator names sit in the linked PDF, so parse that.
Revoked-licence list captures exits and wind-downs that live registers silently drop — strong org-change signal.
Supervision hub is a navigational section of cbcg.me already covered by the specific registers and press-release feed monitored above.
Highest-yield finance-sector job-ad feed for Montenegro, republishing PI vacancies and director-level roles verbatim.
Per-employer tag archives turn Bankar.me into an actor-indexed hiring timeline; pattern extends to every PI in the register.
Licensed PI in visible expansion; own site is primary channel for careers, network growth and management presentation.
Licensed PI with an active corporate blog carrying product, compliance and team announcements — steady signal producer.
Licensed remitter and MoneyGram representative; continuous branch/agent-network hiring plus principal-driven org changes.
Licensed PI / Western Union agent whose site evidences the Alta Pay Group cluster — useful for group-level leadership inference.
Commercial registry aggregator exposing director, owner and headcount per PI — direct proxy for hiring trajectory and leadership change.
Beneficial-ownership register is valuable for control structure but access/query terms unclear; mine on demand rather than monitor.
National employment agency vacancy database gives near-complete formal coverage of advertised roles at banks, PIs and remitters.
Card-acquiring/processing vendor with a Podgorica office — covers the payments-tech employer half the PI register omits.
Commercial Montenegrin job board with Podgorica filtering; catches PI and agent-network roles not routed via ZZZCG.
Regional job portal; cross-border postings from Serbian parent groups can flag Montenegrin team build-outs early.
Redundancy board with low distinct yield; keep as a candidate but revisit after measuring overlap with radnik.me and ZZZCG.
Low-credibility job feed plus a business directory; directory half is a one-off lookup aid rather than a monitored signal source.
General classifieds with weak precision; only marginally relevant for counter-staff hiring at payment agent points.
Money-transfer service page of the national post; in scope as a non-bank payments employer, but monitor postacg.me news/careers rather than this sub-page.
Serbian parent-group hiring portal acts as an early-warning channel for Montenegrin expansion by PaySpot and Alta Pay.
